en.title: FEES Schedule 6, table 6.1 (Providing Money Services, from 2027): measurement period of the "annual transaction value" is not set
en.summary: From 1 January 2027 the variable fee is "calculated on a quarterly basis", but both the threshold (280 million USD) and the base are "the annual transaction value" at "0.0015% p.a.". The text does not say which year's value is used at each quarter or how quarterly charges and any year-end adjustment are worked out. The deferral to 2027 is in a footnote, which is not part of an AIFC Act (section 26 of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
en.correction: Please specify which year supplies the transaction-value base, how quarterly charges and any year-end adjustment are calculated, and move the deferral into the rule.
